purpose: Freeze operator-scenario accessibility assumptions and the H2 materiality rule before any national OneMap routing is executed, so no threshold or materiality definition is chosen after seeing results.
scope_note: This is a configuration artifact only. No routing was executed to produce it; it does not itself contain any accessibility, demand or ranking result.
disclosure: Every timestamp, threshold and distance below is a plausible operator decision scenario for a neighbourhood P1-S4 mathematics tuition outlet, not a measured student- or parent-preference estimate, and not a claim about actual travel behaviour. They are inputs to later sensitivity analysis, not findings.

primary_scenario.journey_timestamp_note: Wednesday, a representative weekday after-school period, Asia/Singapore time. Frozen before routing; not derived from any observed travel pattern.
primary_scenario.proximity_fallback_rule: Used only if OneMap PT and walking routing both fail for a given origin-destination pair after the documented fallback order. A straight-line distance is a proximity proxy, never a travel-time claim, and must populate proximity_proxy rather than transit_reach_share or any minutes-denominated field.
primary_scenario.missing_route_rule: A missing OneMap PT route stays missing and is never imputed. The documented fallback order is: (1) OneMap PT, (2) OneMap walking, (3) EPSG:3414 straight-line proximity at the fallback distance above.

weekend_comparison_scenario.journey_timestamp_note: Saturday morning, Asia/Singapore time, for a weekend-vs-weekday comparison. Frozen before routing.

sensitivity_scenarios.note: These are one-way sensitivity variations on the primary scenario's thresholds/timestamp, not an independent full scenario grid. Combine only as documented when the plausible-scenario grid for financial/Pareto work is later frozen; do not silently cross every sensitivity value with every other without justification.

h2_materiality_rule.hypothesis: H2: transit-aware accessibility produces materially different catchment demand estimates from straight-line proximity.

primary_rule.formula: abs(transit_aware_accessible_population_proxy - straight_line_accessible_population_proxy) / straight_line_accessible_population_proxy, computed per node only where both denominators are valid (not null, not zero)
primary_rule.aggregation: median across all nodes with a valid computation
primary_rule.decision_rule: The overall difference between transit-aware and straight-line accessibility is treated as materially important if and only if the median node-level absolute percentage difference is at least 10%.
primary_rule.zero_or_null_denominator_handling: A node where the straight-line accessible population proxy is null or exactly zero is excluded from the median computation and reported separately as excluded_from_h2_denominator, with a count and the reason (null vs zero) disclosed. It is never treated as a 0% or 100% difference and never silently dropped without being counted.

secondary_descriptive_diagnostics.description: Spearman rank correlation between node demand ordering under transit-aware accessibility and under straight-line proximity.
secondary_descriptive_diagnostics.role: descriptive only; does not replace or retroactively change the primary 10% median rule

secondary_descriptive_diagnostics.description: Share of nodes whose rank position under transit-aware accessibility differs from their rank under straight-line proximity by at least 10 positions.
secondary_descriptive_diagnostics.role: descriptive only; does not replace or retroactively change the primary 10% median rule

h2_materiality_rule.freeze_statement: This rule, threshold and both descriptive diagnostics are frozen on 2026-09-13, before any national OneMap routing is executed and before any node-level accessible-population-proxy result exists. Any later deviation requires a dated decision-log entry explaining why, not a silent change.
